Nine kinds of job, one family-run business.

You do not have to coordinate a plumber, a decorator and a joiner. Tell us the whole list and it gets priced as one job.

  • Handyman jobs

    Taps, light fittings and switches, shelves, mirrors, TV brackets, blinds, curtain rails and flat-pack. Send a list and get one clear price.

  • Painting and decorating

    Inside and out. Wallpaper, panelling, wall repairs and skimming, with Dulux, Valspar and Farrow and Ball colours.

  • Kitchens

    Units, plumbing, tiling and flooring. We can fit a kitchen you have already bought from a supplier.

  • Bathrooms, en-suites and cloakrooms

    From the rip-out to the finishing touches: suite, shower, wall panels or tiles, radiator, flooring and lighting.

  • Wood and laminate flooring

    Supplied and fitted, with new skirting boards or trims.

  • Built-in wardrobes and shelving

    Made to your size, with sliding doors, shelving and rails.

  • Cupboards, boxing in and fireplaces

    Bespoke cupboards, boxing in, and the popular fireplace with a built-in TV and fire.

  • Garden and outdoor

    Decking, pergolas, sheds, fences, gates, raised beds, painting and repairs.

  • Studwork, dry lining and plastering

    Stud walls, plasterboard, skimming, loft boarding and garage conversions.

Not on the list? Ask anyway. Tap replacements, TV brackets, picture hanging, fence painting, radiators and valves, appliance connections and carpet or patio cleaning have all been done. Ask for a quote
